# Spider Math

> Spider Math is an interactive mathematics educational platform and studio directed by Eng. Heba Abdel-Wahab (Heba Ayad), specialized in Egyptian National Curriculum (Thanweya Amma), American Diploma (Digital SAT, EST, ACT), and British Curriculum (IGCSE & A-Levels).

Spider Math provides interactive coursework, diagnostic skill quizzes, video lectures, Desmos-powered graphing workflows, and structured revision plans for high school and preparatory students.

## Platform Features & Diagnostic Engine
- [Spider Math Learning Platform](https://spider-math.vercel.app/): Interactive mathematics learning portal, curriculum selection, course syllabi, and video masterclasses.
- [Diagnostic Assessment Engine](https://spider-math.vercel.app/placement-test): Free intelligent skill evaluation diagnosing strengths and weaknesses to produce a targeted learning path.
- [Knowledge & Topics Directory](https://spider-math.vercel.app/topics): Curated index of key math concepts, formula sheets, and solved problems across all grade levels.
- [Student & Parent Portal Login](https://spider-math.vercel.app/login): Access student dashboard, homework assignments, diagnostic reports, and analytics.

## Curricular Knowledge Modules & Study Guides
- [Thanaweya Amma Differentiation and Integration](https://spider-math.vercel.app/topic/thanweya-amma-differentiation-integration): Comprehensive study guide, rules, and exam practice for calculus.
- [Digital SAT Passport to Advanced Math](https://spider-math.vercel.app/topic/sat-passport-advanced-math): Quadratics, non-linear functions, systems of equations, and Desmos techniques.
- [IGCSE Mathematics Algebra and Functions](https://spider-math.vercel.app/topic/igcse-algebra-functions): Cambridge and Edexcel math modules covering core and extended problem solving.

## Contact & Teacher Information
- [Eng. Heba Abdel-Wahab (Heba Ayad)](https://spider-math.vercel.app/): Lead mathematics engineer, curriculum architect, and educator.
